name: Uwaki Aite no Onna ni Nattemo Ii yo ne? ~Wakazuma Cosplayer wa Netorare Taishitsu~
original_name: 浮気相手のオンナになってもイイよね?～若妻コスプレイヤーは寝取られ体質～
source:
Akari a newly wed cosplayer is as loose as they come,
hooking up with men at events, in the street, anywhere really.
If the guy's willing and she's horny, which is almost always,
she'll go home with him, ditching her husband right then and there.
She's a flagrant and remorseless cheater, a wife who takes
the initiative, who laughs in the face of monogamy.

"I have absolute freedom to fool around."

Her husband, Yuuta, is earnest to a fault.
Because he made the choice of marriage -- a sacred vow --
he's set himself up to be a constant joke.
Watching his wife step out again and again. And again.
(The game is largely from Yuuta's POV.)

Akari could not care less for the sanctity of marriage.
She'll do as she likes, walking all over Yuuta's broken heart.
He shouldn't be surprised, though: she told him from
the beginning she never wanted to be tied to one man.
When she agreed to marry him, it was basically
so she could taste the spice of cheating.
Her love for cosplay is likewise merely a tool of her trade.
No transformation fantasy here. Akari dresses to attract.
To spread her visual pheromones like a bitch in heat...
When her prey is lured in, she's wet ready and wet.
-- and makes sure her cuck hubby knows and sees it all!

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20191001053705mp_/https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE188694.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
Akari是一个新婚的角色扮演者，他们来的时候就很放松，
在活动中、在街上、任何地方与男人勾搭。
如果那个男人愿意并且她很饥渴（这几乎总是如此）她会和他一起回家，当场抛弃她的丈夫。
她是一个明目张胆、无情的骗子，一个不顾一切的妻子
主动，谁笑一笑面对一夫一妻制。

“我有绝对的闲逛自由。”

她的丈夫Yuuta非常认真。
因为他做出了婚姻的选择——神圣的誓言——
他让自己成为一个不断的笑话。
看着自己的妻子一次又一次的走出去。又来了。
（游戏主要来自Yuuta的POV。）明里根本不在乎婚姻的神圣性。
她会随心所欲地走遍悠太破碎的心。
不过，他不应该感到惊讶：她告诉他从
一开始她就不想被一个男人束缚。
当她同意嫁给他时，基本上
这样她就能尝到出轨的滋味。
她对角色扮演的热爱同样只是她的一种工具。
这里没有转型幻想。Akari的着装很吸引人。
像发情的母狗一样传播她的视觉信息素……
当她的猎物被引诱进来时，她已经做好了准备，而且全身湿透。
——并确保她的老公知道并看到这一切！
